listings.d: Maui Mobile RV Service LLC is a mobile RV service that comes to the customer's location on Maui. The site lists 12-volt and 120-volt electric work, plumbing, batteries, dash and roof air conditioners, all appliances, accessory upgrades, solar panels, leveling systems, slide-outs, Aqua Hot and Truma service. It states the technician is RVDA-RVIA certified as an RV service technician and certified service advisor.
listings.spec: RVDA - RVIA Certified RV Service Technician and Certified Service Advisor

coverage_quotes: We can help with all of your RV service needs!!

listings.d: Colors on Parade provides mobile RV body repair on Oahu, focusing on fiberglass repair, gel coat and paint restoration, and scratch and chip repair for RVs, campers, travel trailers and motorhomes. Technicians come to the customer's location with a stocked mobile unit and use the company's EcoSMART small-to-medium area repair technique. It names Kailua, Honolulu, Pearl City, Waipahu, Kapolei, Kaneohe, Haleiwa and the rest of Honolulu County as its service area.
listings.spec: Mobile RV paint, gel coat and fiberglass repair

coverage_quotes: Colors on Parade is your premier choice for efficient fiberglass repair solutions for your RV, camper, travel trailer, or motorhome.
Our skilled technicians come directly to you, wherever you are!

Colors on Parade is proud to serve a wide range of clients throughout the Oahu, HI area, encompassing cities like Kailua, Honolulu, Pearl City, Waipahu, Kapolei, Kaneohe, Haleiwa, and all of the cities and towns in Honolulu County.

listings.d: Custom camper van builder and conversion shop on the North Shore of Oahu, working from a shop in Wahiawa. It builds full van conversions from a bare cargo van and upgrades existing builds, covering layout, carpentry, electrical, plumbing, and finishing. It also services and repairs Volkswagen vans, including the camper portion of Westfalia models.
listings.spec: shop only, no mobile; main work is van builds and conversions

evidence.type_quote: We will service your VW not only mechanically but also with the camper portion of it in case you own a Westfalia model.
coverage_quotes: We design and build custom van conversions out of our shop on the North Shore of Oahu.

listings.d: Mobile restoration service that repairs RV interiors, covering motorhomes, camping trailers, vans, fifth wheels, fold downs, expandables, and toy haulers. It specializes in repair and restoration of interior components such as leather furniture, vinyl lino floors, plastic molding and trim, and fabric. It also performs on-lot repairs and warranty work for RV dealers.

evidence.type_quote: Mobile restoration service to your home or business!
